name: Bunnel Premier Violin Clearance Outfit 1/10 Size — Carrying Case and Accessories Included — Solid Maple Wood and Ebony Fittings By Kennedy Violins
notes: In Andrew's Amazon cart, qty 1 (2026-11-01). He decided to buy; no order confirmation yet, so shortlisted, not ordered (F-08). Shipped and sold by Kennedy Violins, delivery Nov 12 as read 2026-11-01. The listing showed "Returnable until Jan 31, 2027" on one read that day and "30-day refund/replacement" on a later one, so check the date at checkout. Variant 1/10. No dimensions on the page. Kennedy's Portland Oblong case page lists 4/4 to 1/8 only (1/8: 23.5 x 4.75 x 8.5") and no 1/10, so dimensions stay null (F-11): an extra, never placed. Keep it away from heaters: Kennedy's warranty treats damage from dryness as neglect and advises 35% to 55% humidity. Flags: no-dimensions.
